name: Generate full-length film scripts from detailed outlines
description: Users requested the creation of full-length movie or film scripts, often specified as adaptations of video games, anime, or existing franchises, or as original features with detailed plot outlines, character lists, and production credits. The requests varied in genre and tone, ranging from action and science fiction to comedy and horror, with some asking for specific formatting like standard screenplays or shot-by-shot breakdowns.
